author: AgentTeams
description: AgentTeams TeamHarness runtime plugin for OpenClaw. install.sh projects the bundle contract onto the OpenClaw runtime: the MCP server entry lands in openclaw.json (mcp.servers.teamharness) and this plugin is registered; this manifest declares the skills roots. The manifest carries no MCP keys: OpenClaw only reads documented manifest fields, and MCP servers are plain runtime configuration.
name: TeamHarness
